rationales: Correct: is the HTML tag used to embed an image.
<scr> is not the HTML image tag.

Encryption protects data and is not itself a cybercrime.
Copyright is a legal protection, not a cybercrime.
Correct: piracy is the unauthorized copying or distribution of copyrighted material.
Hacking can be a cybercrime, but piracy is the expected simple example here.
HTML provides more than three heading levels.
HTML provides more than four heading levels.
HTML provides more than five heading levels.
Correct: HTML has six heading levels, from <h1> to <h6>.
Four is fewer than the usual minimum of eight characters for a password.
Six is fewer than the usual minimum of eight characters for a password.
Correct: the intended guideline is a password of at least eight characters; the question likely means characters, not words.
Ten is not the stated minimum in this question.
<tB> is not the HTML tag for creating a table.
Correct: the <table> tag displays data in tabular form.
<tM> is not the HTML tag for creating a table.
<tS> is not the HTML tag for creating a table.
Protocols define communication rules; a router does not connect protocols to each other in this sense.
Channels are communication paths, not what routers connect to each other.
Correct: a router connects multiple networks.
Addresses identify devices or destinations; routers connect networks.
FTP is used for file transfer, not email transmission.
HTTP is used for web communication, not sending email.
STP is not the standard email protocol intended here.
Correct: SMTP is used to send email.
Four bits make half a byte.
Six bits are not the standard size of a byte.
Correct: one byte contains eight bits.
Ten bits are not the standard size of a byte.
Correct: RAM holds data and instructions available to the processor for processing.
ROM generally stores permanent instructions and is not the usual working memory supplying data to the processor.
USB is an interface or storage device, not the processor's primary working memory.
A hard disk provides long-term storage; data is normally loaded into RAM for processing.
A diamond is not the standard flowchart symbol for input.
Correct: a diamond represents a decision or condition.
A process is usually shown by a rectangle.
A connector is usually shown by a small circle or a labeled connector symbol.
A row records values during tracing rather than the name of the data.
Column number is not what a trace-table row represents.
Correct: each row shows the data values at a step in the trace.
A row does not represent the name of the table.
Authentication can be covered by communication protocols.
Error detection can be covered by communication protocols.
Some protocols provide error correction.
Correct: protocols can cover authentication, error detection, and correction.
A computer address is not the standard name for the address carried in an IP packet.
A MAC address is used for link-layer addressing and is not the intended answer for every data packet.
Correct: an IP packet carries an IP address, including source and destination addressing information.
A home address is unrelated to network packets.
Correct: an official data breach notification is not inherently a phishing characteristic, though fake notices may imitate one.
A request to update an email account can be used as a phishing lure.
An IT reminder can be used as a phishing lure.
A domain resembling a genuine website is a common phishing tactic.
Circuit Television is incomplete and not the expansion of CCTV.
Real Television is not the expansion of CCTV.
Correct: CCTV stands for Closed-Circuit Television.
Closed Television omits the word Circuit.
